title: Product review for our new Range Hood STAR ..........!
description:
Looking to get rid of smoke, grime and oily residue generated from cooking in your kitchen? Glam Gas extensive collection of duct-ed, range hoods offers the perfect size and style for every kitchen. 
Glam Gas hood model STAR is characterized by the combination of Black Tampered glass and steel. Available in sizes 60, 70 and 90 cm. Includes 3-speed electronic button panel with a minimum noise level, 2 LED lamps and an extraction capacity at the peak of 2200+-10% ft/min.
